pages.text: $(thing)Champions$() (via Champions Unofficial) are elite mob variants that spawn with custom affixes. They glow, are significantly more dangerous than standard mobs, and drop better loot.$(br2)Champions are the primary source of good early affix items. Killing one is always worth the effort.

pages.title: Spawn Scaling
pages.text: Champion spawn rates scale per dimension:$(br2)$(bold)Overworld$() — ~8% base rate$(br)$(bold)Twilight/Aether$() — ~12%$(br)$(bold)Nether/Undergarden$() — ~16%$(br)$(bold)End/Deep Aether$() — ~20%$(br2)Higher-tier dimensions spawn more Champions and at higher ranks. A Rank 4 Champion in the End is a genuine boss-level encounter.

pages.title: Champion Ranks
pages.text: $(bold)Rank 1 (Common)$() — 1 affix. Slightly buffed stats.$(br)$(bold)Rank 2 (Elite)$() — 2 affixes. Noticeably stronger.$(br)$(bold)Rank 3 (Champion)$() — 3 affixes. Serious threat. Good loot.$(br)$(bold)Rank 4 (Legendary)$() — 4 affixes. Boss-level threat. Excellent loot.$(br2)Higher ranks are rarer. Rank 4 $(thing)Champions$() are uncommon enough to be memorable encounters.

pages.title: Custom IridescentCraft Affixes
pages.text: Champions draw from 16 built-in affixes plus $(bold)5 custom IridescentCraft affixes$():$(br2)$(bold)Commanding$() — Buffs nearby mobs with damage and speed$(br)$(bold)Draining$() — Leeches your mana and XP on hit$(br)$(bold)Hexing$() — Applies random debuffs on attack$(br)$(bold)Leaping$() — Closes distance instantly, punishes ranged kiting$(br)$(bold)Summoning$() — Spawns reinforcement mobs$(br2)$(italic)Commanding + Summoning in a cave is a death sentence.$() Play carefully around multi-affix Champions.
